d:
The Yamaha R2 slots between the popular R15 and the larger R3, bringing an all-new 204cc engine, more performance and a host of premium features. We put it through its paces to see how it performs in the city, out on the highway, and some twisty roads to see whether it justifies the premium over the R15.
Cameraperson: Harshad Panchal
Editor: Siddhesh Bhogale
